Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the MANIT Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the MANIT Bhopal recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech with a valid GATE score, or M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in any field of Engineering or Science.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 32 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the MANIT Bhopal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (MANIT Bhopal).
